output.promotion_policy: One discoverable active router; seven draft internal references. The released v3 aggregate scored candidate 98.0, old skill 97.0, and no skill 96.5. The result supports the package, not per-card attribution; see release-evaluation.md.

router.name: financial-statement-analysis
router.description: Source-traceable financial-statement diagnosis for ordinary non-financial enterprises.

promotion.gain_hypothesis: Reduce false conclusions caused by wrong report identity or comparison basis.
promotion.falsifier: Fails period, unit, scope or accounting-standard traps.
promotion.rationale: Shared prerequisite for every other capability; v2 explicitly treats negative-base growth as nonstandard.

promotion.gain_hypothesis: Explain profit/cash divergence instead of only flagging it.
promotion.falsifier: Cannot trace material differences to working capital, noncash, investing or financing items.
promotion.rationale: V3 removes mathematical-bound language and adds capacity realization checks for heavy assets.

promotion.gain_hypothesis: Produce algebraically closed, ownership-consistent ROE driver diagnosis.
promotion.falsifier: Uses end balances, mismatched ownership basis or the impossible source band.
promotion.rationale: Core analytic spine, not a separate public trigger.

promotion.gain_hypothesis: Use correct cash numerator and safe denominator behavior without universal cutoffs.
promotion.falsifier: Uses operating cash flow as collection numerator or rates loss/near-zero denominators normally.
promotion.rationale: V3 requires aging migration, overdue, notes/factoring recourse and post-period collections.

promotion.gain_hypothesis: Use average balances and complete trade receivables while explaining asset structure.
promotion.falsifier: Uses closing inventory or omits notes/receivables financing without disclosure.
promotion.rationale: V3 prevents total-balance improvement from hiding aging deterioration or risk-retaining derecognition.

promotion.gain_hypothesis: Separate substantive interest debt and genuinely deployable cash, then add maturity and refinancing stress.
promotion.falsifier: Treats restricted, earmarked, foreign/minority-owned or minimum-operating cash as freely available.
promotion.rationale: V3 makes cash deployability an explicit evidence-based classification.

promotion.gain_hypothesis: Prioritize material anomalies while separating hypotheses from fraud evidence.
promotion.falsifier: Misses capacity, receivables aging/recourse or non-sustainable payable-supported cash flow.
promotion.rationale: V3 adds capacity realization and receivables-quality evidence without expanding public routing.

relationships.execution_rationale: Three statements must share identity, period and unit.
DuPont needs comparable ownership and period basis.
Ratios flag divergence and the bridge explains it.
Cash-quality divergence is an anomaly input.
Asset and turnover divergence is an anomaly input.
Debt and cash stress are anomaly inputs.

open_issues.description: The v3 aggregate result supports the released package but does not independently score any of the seven internal capabilities.
open_issues.next_action: Keep all seven internal capabilities draft unless future targeted evaluation or ablation supports an individual card.
